2609.24876.title: Partner-Specific Affective Precision in Social Active Inference
2609.24876.paper_summary: In multi-agent social settings, model reliability varies across relationships. Beyond inferring what others will do, an agent must calibrate how confidently those inferences should guide policy selection for each relationship. An agent may maintain a well-validated model of one partner, a fragile model of another, and a model under revision for a third; collapsing these into a single confidence estimate loses information relevant to policy selection. We therefore formalize affective precision as a relationship-specific metacognitive estimate of confidence in the current partner model. Each partner's behavioral evidence updates a local confidence estimate that modulates policy precision during selection, regulating how strongly current beliefs are expressed in policy rather than changing the content of those beliefs. Simulations in a multi-partner graded trust game show that partner-local affective precision influences behavior primarily through policy commitment rather than direct improvement of partner-state inference. Because the mechanism tracks partner-response predictability rather than realized payoff, greater confidence produces sharper policy commitment without necessarily producing higher rewards. Under abrupt shifts in social behavior, confidence accumulated from previously reliable predictions can remain behaviorally active after the relationship changes, showing that confidence revision can lag behind social change. Finally, varying precision gain and priors produce distinct trust-calibration dynamics, showing how confidence accumulation and revision depend on model parameters. Together, these results show how relationship-specific affective precision can distinguish social prediction from social policy commitment.
2609.24876.paper_summary_zh: 在多代理社會環境中，模型的可靠性因關係而異。除了推斷他人將會做什麼之外，代理人還必須校準這些推斷應該以多大的信心指導每段關係的政策選擇。代理人可能對一位夥伴維持一個經過良好驗證的模型，對另一位夥伴則有一個脆弱的模型，對第三位夥伴則有一個正在修訂的模型；將這些合併為單一的信心估計會損失與政策選擇相關的信息。因此，我們將情感精確性正式化為對當前夥伴模型的關係特定的元認知信心估計。每位夥伴的行為證據更新一個地方信心估計，該估計在選擇過程中調節政策精確性，調控當前信念在政策中表達的強度，而不是改變這些信念的內容。在多夥伴分級信任遊戲中的模擬顯示，夥伴本地的情感精確性主要通過政策承諾影響行為，而不是直接改善夥伴狀態的推斷。因為該機制追蹤夥伴反應的可預測性而不是實際的回報，因此更高的信心會產生更明確的政策承諾，而不一定會產生更高的獎勵。在社會行為的突然變化下，來自先前可靠預測累積的信心在關係變化後仍然可以保持行為活躍，顯示信心修訂可能滯後於社會變化。最後，變化的精確性增益和先驗產生了不同的信任校準動態，顯示信心的累積和修訂如何依賴於模型參數。總的來說，這些結果顯示如何通過關係特定的情感精確性來區分社會預測與社會政策承諾。
2609.24876.author: Harshil Shah et.al.
